themes.label: GLP-1 and obesity drug demand
themes.rationale: AstraZeneca is expanding its obesity/metabolic pipeline (e.g. oral GLP-1 candidates) to compete in the fast-growing weight-loss drug market, exposing it to the same demand wave reshaping Novo Nordisk and Eli Lilly economics.

themes.label: Biopharma patent cliff and generic erosion
themes.rationale: Several AZN blockbusters face loss of exclusivity this decade, pressuring revenue unless offset by pipeline launches; a structural force common to large-cap pharma valuations.

themes.label: Oncology drug pipeline innovation
themes.rationale: AZN's growth strategy leans heavily on oncology franchises (Tagrisso, Enhertu, Imfinzi); success of next-gen cancer therapeutics is a recurring theme across biopharma peers.

themes.label: Drug pricing and government reimbursement policy
themes.rationale: US IRA price negotiation and global reimbursement pressure directly affect AZN's revenue mix and pricing power, a cross-industry regulatory force for pharma companies.
